info.name: Nimap FieldForceConnect - API Testing
info.description:
Postman collection for the Nimap machine test.

AUTH MECHANISM (confirmed via DevTools): This app is NOT Bearer-token based. Login returns a JSON body (success/userId/CompanyDetail/...), and the frontend JS builds a 'currentUser' cookie from that JSON itself (not sent via Set-Cookie). A 'DeviceId' cookie IS sent via Set-Cookie by the server and is handled automatically by Postman's cookie jar. The Tests script on 'Login - Valid Credentials' replicates the frontend behavior by writing the currentUser cookie via pm.cookies.jar() (with an environment-variable fallback), and every authenticated request's Pre-request Script attaches it as a Cookie header.

CONFIRMED endpoints: Login = POST {{base_url}}{{login_endpoint}} (/api/account/authenticate), Customer/Leads list = POST {{base_url}}{{get_customers_endpoint}} (/api/CRM/Leads).
STILL UNCONFIRMED: exact request-body field names for Login (guessed below - verify from the Payload tab of a real login request), and the Add Customer endpoint/payload (not yet captured from DevTools).

exec: // Frontend builds the 'currentUser' cookie from the FULL login response JSON.
// Server does not send it via Set-Cookie, so we replicate that here.
if (err) console.log('Cookie jar set failed, using env var fallback:', err);

request.description: Confirmed endpoint: POST /api/account/authenticate. Confirmed success response shape: { success: true, userId, CompanyDetail: { GroupId, CompanyId, ... }, ... }. Confirmed failure shape (still HTTP 200!): { success: false, errormessage: 'Invalid Email Id / Mobile No or Password.' } - note for the write-up: the API returns 200 even on bad credentials, so failure can only be detected from the success field, not the status code. Request body field names below (username/password) are NOT yet confirmed - open the Payload tab of a real login request in DevTools and correct the keys to match (e.g. may be EmailId/Password).

request.description: Confirmed endpoint: POST /api/CRM/Leads. Confirmed real request body (filter/pagination payload - see body). Confirmed real response shape: { Status: 200, Message: 'Success', data: { TotalRecords, Leads: [ { Id, LeadName, PersonName, StatusId, Status, MobileNo, Email, LeadTypeId/Name, LeadStageId/Name, CreatedDate, ModifiedDate, ... } ] } } - note customers are actually called 'Leads' in this API (StatusId 3 = 'Cold' stage by default for all of them here). Auth is via the currentUser + DeviceId cookies (see Pre-request Script) - not a Bearer token.
